signature.description: An inline attestation (badge.blue format) by an #eventside_attest key in the signer's DID document. It signs the CIDv1 (dag-cbor, sha2-256) of the record without `signatures`, plus `$sig`: this entry without `signature`, plus `repository`, the DID of the repo holding the record.

key.description: The signing key, as `{signer did}#eventside_attest…`. The signer is the conference space's managing app.

signature.description: A low-S P-256 signature, 64 bytes r||s.

rank.description: The weight a decision was made with, kept whatever happens to its maker's role later.
